name: sol-warzone
description: Live SOL/USDC order-flow visualised as a 3D battle: Orcs vs Nexus

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sol-warzone/protocol && npm run build -w @sol-warzone/web && npm run build -w @sol-warzone/collector
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @sol-warzone/collector && npm run clean -w @sol-warzone/protocol && npm run clean -w @sol-warzone/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p apps/collector && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
